cc: "margaret.thomas@lumieresante.fr" <margaret.thomas@lumieresante.fr> 
Subject: RE: Lyon Regional


Dear Aimé / Margaret,

Thanks for coming to Lyon to present an overview of the initiatives. We enjoyed meeting you and your colleagues and look forward to working with Lumière Santé. I would also like to pass on my team's appreciation for the dinner as well.

We wanted to give you an update on our initiative and get some feedback and additional information prior to our upcoming visit to Marseille on January 29th. Our initiative is going to be geared to the third option you mentioned. We plan on addressing some part of Clinical Operations. We are considering two options regarding this topic and would like to pursue either (i) how patients are admitted and recommending new processes and ways to improve patient intake, OR (ii) studying the medical supply chain and coming up with recommendations for areas for further investment.

However, we would like to get some more information on the Patient Care Services before truly scoping the project. We are also very open to suggestions, especially if you had a much broader or different scope in mind; so please let us know.

We have not yet reviewed the introductory information received last week, but here are the questions we have specific to Clinical Operations:

Can we look at its overall business plan or a more detailed summary than is in the annual report?  
What is the pricing philosophy/overall structure?  
Who are the patients and how are they admitted?  
What would the patients be doing if they did not work with Lumière Santé?  
What are the international expansion plans and capabilities?  
Is there any important regulatory summary information we can have?  

If this information is not already covered in the review material you sent, will you be able to recommend other sources where we may find such information?

After we have reviewed the material sent to us recently, we may want to schedule a phone call with you and/or one of your colleagues directly involved in Clinical Operations. I would like to call you in the new year to discuss this further. In the meantime, please feel free to call me at +33 4 59 27 70 77 if you need any information.

Regards,  
Patient Care Services Task Force  
Ram  
Dennis  
Jason  
Omar  
Steve  
Clay
